entries.Original:
AutoLogin is an Anti-DDoS module that will store the details of your last-known active character and attempt to automatically reconnect to them in the event of a sudden disconnect.
In addition, AutoLogin prevents your client from killing itself on any lobby/disconnection errors.
entries.Translated:
自动登录是一个防 DDoS 模块，会保存你最后活跃角色的信息，并在突然断线时尝试自动重连。
此外，自动登录可防止客户端因任何大厅/断线错误而自行退出。

entries.Original:
Experimental: Will attempt to restart your client in the event of an Auth Error.
Some notes on this:
If you have an OTP on your account you will need to use the XIV Auth App
If you do not enable "Log in automatically" in XIVLauncher this will not work.
If you do not set up commands or AR Multi on launch, this will only log you back into your last character, nothing else.
You are using this feature entirely at your own risk - It is literally accessing files on your PC to open clients.
entries.Translated:
实验性：将在发生认证错误时尝试重启客户端。
几点说明：
如果你的账号启用了 OTP，你需要使用 XIV Auth App
如果你未在 XIVLauncher 中启用“自动登录”，此功能将无效。
如果你未在启动时设置命令或 AR Multi，此功能只会让你重新登录到上一个角色，仅此而已。
使用此功能完全风险自负 - 它实际上会访问你电脑上的文件来打开客户端。

entries.Original: Launches a new client using your settings, and kills this one - resetting your Auth Token.
entries.Translated: 使用你的设置启动新客户端，并关闭当前客户端——重置你的认证令牌。

entries.Original:
KitchenSink is a collection of small utility tools, overlays, and QoL commands originally put together by Liza.
Character Switching helpers, Dropbox helpers, GlamourSet Tracking, OC Carrot Markers, and more!
Some features require specific plugins (e.g. AutoRetainer, Dropbox) to be installed.
entries.Translated:
KitchenSink 是一系列小型实用工具、悬浮窗和便捷命令的集合，最初由 Liza 整理。
包含角色切换助手、Dropbox 助手、幻化套装追踪、OC 胡萝卜标记等！
部分功能需要安装特定插件（如 AutoRetainer、Dropbox）。

entries.Original:
AutoRetainer enables some character-aware features in KitchenSink:

• Character switching commands (/k+, /k-, /ks)
• DTR bar character index display
• Character storing for leve count indicators

entries.Original:
Workshoppa is a workshop project manager and automator originally created by Liza,
now completely rewritten using ECommons and fully integrated into VIWI.
Workshoppa allows you to queue multiple company projects and automatically turn in the required materials
to progress each project to its next stage.
Additionally, Workshoppa includes features for automatically purchasing Grade 6 Dark Matter for repair kits,
as well as recursively purchasing ceruleum fuel tanks from the FC mammet.
entries.Translated:
Workshoppa 是一个工坊项目管理和自动化工具，最初由 Liza 创建，
现已使用 ECommons 完全重写并完全集成到 VIWI 中。
Workshoppa 允许你排队多个部队项目，并自动提交所需材料
以推进每个项目进入下一阶段。
此外，Workshoppa 还包含自动购买用于修理工具的 6 级暗物质的功能，
以及从部队人偶处递归购买青磷水罐的功能。
